email_subject: An Instagram carousel idea: Ten Thousand gear in a hard outdoor session
email_body:
Dear Ten Thousand Marketing Team,

We propose collaborating on an Instagram carousel post that shows Ten Thousand's gear in action during demanding outdoor training sessions. This builds on the brand's reported focus on quality and functionality for serious athletes {C2} and on durability and minimalist design {C3}. Each slide would feature your gear in motion through a different part of the session.

If this sounds interesting, we'd be happy to share a draft.

Best regards,
[Your Team]
